measures.title: Portage County Job and Family Services – Proposed Tax Levy (Additional)
measures.summary: Asks whether Portage County may levy an additional property tax of up to 0.4 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027, for the Portage County Department of Job and Family Services. The money would pay for public assistance, human or social services (including children and adult services), and relief. The county auditor estimates it will collect $2,451,896 a year, or $14 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The additional 0.4-mill levy for Job and Family Services takes effect for 5 years.
measures.noMeans: The additional levy is not imposed.

measures.title: Portage County Mental Health and Recovery Board – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal)
measures.summary: Asks whether to renew a property tax of up to 0.3 mill for 10 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028, for the Mental Health and Recovery Board of Portage County. The money funds the county's mental health and recovery services district, including alcohol and drug addiction programs and mental health programs. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,157,027 a year, or $6 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.3-mill mental health and recovery levy is renewed for 10 years.
